clean.tx: nambɪliile fyosa ɪfi mumbeele, kangɪ nʊkʊkɪndapo palɪ ɪfi naalondaga
clean.tl: But I have all, and abound. [lit. I have received everything that you have given me and even more than what I needed]’ (Philippians 4:18)

clean.tx: ʊkabagɪla ʊkʊndola ʊne, paapo ɪfinyamaana bo ɪmbabala, ɪɪsenjebele nɪfinyamaana ɪfingɪ, ɪfi ʊfimeenye ʊkʊtɪ fikʊbopa fiijo ʊlʊbɪlo, fyope figelilemo ʊkʊtolana naniine, fyosa naafitolile
clean.tl: You can't beat me, because animals like Gazelle, Zebra and many animals that you know to race fast have [at some point] tried to compete with me, I beat them all.' [Hare and Chameleon]
